# DEX223 app

> The DEX223 app (app.dex223.io) is a non-custodial decentralized exchange for ERC-223 and ERC-20 tokens on Ethereum. You can swap, provide liquidity, convert tokens between ERC-20 and ERC-223 at 1:1, list a token without permission, and lend, borrow and trade on margin. You trade from your own wallet and sign every transaction yourself.

The project, its token D223 and its company DEX223 DAO LLC are described at https://www.dex223.io/llms.txt.

## What you can do

- [Swap](https://app.dex223.io/en/swap): trade ERC-20 and ERC-223 tokens. Every pool accepts both standards, and you choose the standard for each side. ERC-223 swaps need no approval transaction.
- [Pools](https://app.dex223.io/en/pools): browse pools and their liquidity. [Add liquidity](https://app.dex223.io/en/add) to earn the pool's trading fees (concentrated liquidity with fee tiers).
- [Token converter](https://app.dex223.io/en/converter): convert a token between its ERC-20 and ERC-223 versions at 1:1 (EIP-7417). No protocol fee.
- [Token listing](https://app.dex223.io/en/token-listing): list any token without permission by paying an anti-spam fee to an auto-listing contract. [Auto-listing contracts](https://app.dex223.io/en/token-listing/contracts) shows the available contracts and their fees.
- [Create a token](https://app.dex223.io/en/create-token): deploy a new token.
- [Margin trading](https://app.dex223.io/en/margin-trading): lend tokens on your own terms or borrow them. Borrowers trade borrowed tokens on [Margin swap](https://app.dex223.io/en/margin-swap) but cannot withdraw them. Margin trading is live on the Sepolia testnet.
- [Statistics](https://app.dex223.io/en/statistics) and [Markets](https://app.dex223.io/en/markets): pool and token data with price charts.
- [Revenue](https://app.dex223.io/en/revenue): protocol revenue shared with D223 holders.
- [Interactive demo](https://app.dex223.io/en/demo): a guided walkthrough without a wallet.

## Common questions

- Do I need ERC-223 tokens to use it? No. Every pool accepts both standards, and the converter moves tokens between them at 1:1.
- How do I list my token? Open Token listing, pick an auto-listing contract and confirm. No application or approval from the team is needed.
- Is DEX223 custodial? No. DEX223 never holds your keys.
- What does it cost? The pool's fee tier, which goes to its liquidity providers, plus network gas. Converting between ERC-20 and ERC-223 has no protocol fee.
- Which wallets work? Any Web3 wallet, such as MetaMask or a WalletConnect wallet.
